_about: Recordings that must not be used for training. 'sources' drops whole datasets; 'ids' drops single recordings. Grades come from a visual audit (two independent passes over all 1,713 candidate words, 2026-11-25): unusable = at least one pass saw a scrawl, a label mismatch or stray strokes; hasty = both passes found it rushed; borderline = one pass found it rushed.
